Dr Ed Ellison - Part 1.quote: I was born in a small town in Virginia, Radford, Virginia. I became a physician because of an experience I had when I was five years old. I developed rheumatic fever, and at that time, there wasn't a lot that you could do. You. I was placed on steroids and penicillin and put on bed rest for a year. It was really discouraging and kind of scary. I would see my friends outside running and playing, but I wasn't allowed to do that. We had a wonderful pediatrician who actually made house calls, and he was reassuring to my family and to me, and fortunately I did well. I did not have any issues as a result, but it absolutely impacted me. And when I saw the impact that this physician had on me and my family, I thought, that's what I want to do. I want to be like him. And that's what led me to be a physician.
Dr Ed Ellison - Part 1.speaker: Ed Ellison, MD
Dr Ed Ellison - Part 1.rationale: Gives birthplace and the childhood illness/pediatrician story that inspired him to become a doctor.

Dr Ed Ellison - Part 1.quote: I ultimately went to Duke University in Durham, North Carolina, and then University of Virginia and medical school and then went to my training in Florida, Halifax Hospital, Medical Center, and family medicine.

Dr Ed Ellison - Part 1.quote: So moving to California was a dream. We had moved around so much when I was a child and I had lived in north, south, east, west, but for about eight glorious months when I was 11 years old, we lived in California and in the mid 60s that was living the dream.
